title: Ledger and Quill
purpose: Record-keeping and accountability surfaces; brand still-life accent.
story: A heavy ledger lying open with a quill across its blank pages — the act of recording, paused and waiting.

architecture: Implied only — a panelled room suggested beyond the pool of light.
composition: The open ledger angled in the foreground, the quill resting across blank pages, one warm highlight on the gilt edge, deep negative space around.
objects: a single candle out of frame
